main_measure.name: mean unusual 120-bar move of long bets (one per 120-bar grid cell)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 30 cases

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, upper-break half minus lower-break half

decided_by: Mean unusual move above 0 with t >= 2, and the larger-break half beats the smaller-break half.
reading: Cases are the first long bet (forecast rise >= 2 points from its lowest long level since the last bet) in each 120-bar grid cell counted from each window's first row, dropped if t+120 leaves the window; the upper half is raw break strictly above the median of the cases, the lower half at or below it.
